findings.reader: This dated notice cleanly explains the change from per-variant computation to precomputed lookup, walks a concrete rare-epilepsy prediction-to-laboratory sequence without diagnosis, cure or misleading fractions, and hands the reader a reusable three-question test for gene-prediction headlines. Voice, clarity, analogy and limits all hold; no failure family is present.
findings.facts: All five material claims — release, nine-billion scale, epilepsy case, minigene experiment, and clinical-evidence limitation — are supported by the assigned DeepMind blog and technical report passages, with attribution and limits intact. Dating and sourcing make the piece reviewable, and hedged language keeps confidence proportionate to evidence.
